description:
Find the next occurrence(s) of a sun event (sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, solarNoon, night, nightEnd, goldenHourStart, goldenHourEnd, nauticalDawn, nauticalDusk, astronomicalDawn, astronomicalDusk) at a location from a starting date.

Use for: "when is sunset today?", planning golden-hour photography or dawn fishing around tide windows.

date.description: Search start date. Defaults to today.

response_format.description: Output format: "markdown" for a readable summary table, "json" for the complete structured payload.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for output times (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to UTC ISO timestamps.

name: astro_get_next_sun_event
title: Get Next Sun Event
